components.usage: Bundled in src/resources and publicly served under /resources/, but not loaded by any page of the product.

components.name: modernizr
components.usage: Bundled in src/resources/js and publicly served under /resources/, but not loaded by any page of the product.

components.name: yepnope
components.description: yepnope resource loader, embedded in the Modernizr build

components.name: font-awesome
components.declared: Font: SIL OFL 1.1, CSS: MIT License
components.description: Font Awesome icon font and CSS
components.usage: CSS loaded at runtime from a CDN by src/index.php (file icons on the standard pages); the CSS in turn loads the web fonts from the same CDN.

components.name: PHP
components.usage: Runs src/index.php, src/listDescriptions.php, the help pages and the webhook in src/autodeploy; the README names PHP 7.2 as the version in use.

components.name: PHP zip extension
components.usage: ZipArchive unpacks the release zip in src/autodeploy/releasecreated.php.

components.name: PHP openssl extension
components.usage: Needed for fopen() and file_get_contents() on https URLs (GitHub configuration files and release zips) in src/autodeploy.

components.name: Apache HTTP Server
components.usage: Serves the site and the directory listings with mod_rewrite, configured with conf/apache2/rewrite-rules.txt and conf/apache2/artefact-directories.txt (Require syntax of Apache 2.4).
